 Juventus-Napoli is the second big clash to round off Sunday's action in the 10th round of Serie A 2026/2027. The match already carries weight for Luciano Spalletti 's Juventus and Massimiliano Allegri 's Napoli. Both have 14 points, nine behind fourth-placed Como, whose position would secure a Champions League place.
 After a thrilling 3-3 draw with Roma and a convincing 4-1 away win over Monza, De Bruyne and his team-mates are showing signs of improvement. Juventus, meanwhile, suffered their second defeat in three league matches in Genoa, producing a display well below Spalletti's expectations.
 Juventus-Napoli 1-0
 SCORER: 70' Alajbegovic (J)
 Goals and highlights
 75' NAPOLI DOWN TO 10 - Marianucci clearly steps on Cabal's foot, leaving Sozza no choice but to show him a yellow card. It's his second, so the red follows.
 74' CHANCE - Boga plays in Koopmeiners, who reaches the byline unmarked and crosses into the area. Woltemade falls after contact with Olivera.
 70' GOAL - What a goal from Alajbegovic! Zhegrova breaks through Napoli's press and surges forward before laying the ball off to the Bosnian playmaker on the right of centre. Alajbegovic doesn't hesitate. His thunderous diagonal shot strikes the post to Meret's left and flies into the net.
 58' WHAT A MISTAKE! Lucumì falls under pressure from Politano and, as he slides, knocks the ball back towards Vicario. It falls short. The Napoli winger races onto it, but Vicario rushes off his line and gets there just ahead of him to take the ball cleanly.
 45+2' CHANCE - Meret makes a superb save this time. Alajbegovic takes matters into his own hands just inside the area and shoots across goal, but the alert Napoli goalkeeper dives to his left to keep it out.
 31' CHANCE - At the other end, Kolo Muani reaches the byline and sends a high cut-back towards Alajbegovic. Unmarked, Alajbegovic sets himself, but his right-footed effort goes just over.
 30' CHANCE - Anguissa wins the ball back and finds Politano, who crosses into the middle for Lang. With the goal at his mercy, Lang shoots over.
 28' POST - A cross from the right ricochets off Cabal's body and strikes the post to Meret's right. As the move continues, Cabal falls in the area and appeals for a penalty after contact with Olivera.
 16' CHANCE - Koopmeiners takes the corner and Lucumì meets it with his knee in the middle of the area, sending the ball just over.
 11' KOOPMEINERS RISKS A RED CARD - Koopmeiners catches Anguissa first on the calf and then on the ankle as he tries to take the ball from him. Sozza doesn't even show a yellow card. Napoli wanted a red (READ THE REFEREEING ANALYSIS HERE)
 7' CHANCE - Napoli have the first real chance of the match after a sustained attack down the right leads to a cross from Politano. Lucca gets into a good position in the middle of the area despite Bremer's challenge and heads towards goal, but Vicario makes a superb save to turn it behind for a corner and keep the scores level.
 0' Kick-off is at 8.45pm at the Allianz Stadium in Turin.

 Substitutes: Contini, Spinelli, Barido, Giovane, Pereyra, Chiummariello, Melnyk, Lieto.
